cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I drew that floating staircase last week. Mention the date. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can all see it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.

mechanism: A directs visitors upstairs and shortens a demanded prediction reading while still seeking public priority credit for the impossible staircase.
confusable: Unlike ordinary praise for good work, the required acknowledgment is that A predicted the impossible before it existed.
comparison: Public visitor credit and a moving queue differ from written acknowledgment to respect a talking cupboard silence.
seedUse: D153-a drawing, date and staircase visitors; S02-a negotiates a shorter acknowledgment while managing the group.
